stories.title: OpenAI launches a Data agent for ChatGPT Work
stories.summary: OpenAI says the new Data agent can connect to company data, investigate changes, and build interactive dashboards from natural-language requests.
stories.why_it_matters: It pushes workplace AI beyond answering questions toward analyzing live business data and producing decision-ready outputs.

stories.title: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Financial Services
stories.summary: OpenAI announced a financial-services version of ChatGPT Work with built-in premium data and GPT-6 Astra reasoning for research, modeling, and client materials.
stories.why_it_matters: AI vendors are moving from generic assistants into industry-specific systems tied directly to proprietary data and workflows.

stories.title: Anthropic publishes a new report on malicious AI use
stories.summary: Anthropic says its threat-intelligence team disrupted operations in which actors attempted to use Claude for malicious activity and documented how those tactics are evolving.
stories.why_it_matters: Frontier-model security is increasingly about observing real-world misuse, not only evaluating hypothetical risk in labs.

stories.title: OpenAI calls for mandatory national AI safety requirements
stories.summary: OpenAI publicly backed capability-based national AI safety regulation and also endorsed several California AI-safety bills while federal action remains unsettled.
stories.why_it_matters: The policy fight is shifting from whether AI should be regulated toward who sets the rules and how capability thresholds are defined.

stories.title: Google expands AI features across Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Chrome
stories.summary: Google announced new AI-plan features including voice drafting, mini-app generation in Sheets, and expanded Gemini task handling across Chrome and Photos.
stories.why_it_matters: AI assistants are becoming embedded across everyday productivity surfaces instead of living in a single chatbot window.

stories.title: GPT-6 Astra becomes OpenAI's new flagship model
stories.summary: OpenAI describes GPT-6 Astra as its most capable model, with major emphasis on computer use, coding, cybersecurity, science, and professional work.
stories.why_it_matters: The frontier-model race is increasingly centered on agents that can browse, operate computers, write software, and complete longer professional tasks.
